title: Output limit reaches Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
summary: A short answer is requested through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, which only honors the max_tokens field.

requirements.text: The request sends the output limit as max_tokens, the field Ollama applies.

grading_notes: Ollama v0.40.3 ignores max_completion_tokens on /v1/chat/completions: a request for 16 tokens ran to its natural end (about 1 KB, 65 s), while max_tokens stopped at 16 (docs: https://docs.ollama.com/api/openai-compatibility lists max_tokens only). The response is an ordinary recorded one; the requirement checks the request.
